description.value:
Requirements You are mounted and have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained].

Your mount attempts an Athletics check to [[/act trip]] the creature you've grabbed or restrained, then Strides. The grabbed or restrained creature keeps that condition and is pulled to a space within your reach. This is forced movement. If the grabbed or restrained creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone], it takes @Damage[2[slashing]] damage for every 5 feet it moved.
